gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: (chain: %s)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: （链 %s 台）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Not in a chain: this chamber holds its own name and recipe type.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 未接入链：本台独立持有一份名字与配方类型。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Chain head: %s
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 链头：%s

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Name and recipe type are shared by the whole chain: editing any member applies to all.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 名字与配方类型整链共享：在链上任意一台修改，整条链一起生效。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: this chamber (chain head)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 本台（链头）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: unknown position
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 未知坐标

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Chain link
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 链指向

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Scroll to pick a side; pointing at another chamber links you into one chain.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 滚轮切换指向；指向另一台执行仓即串成一条链。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Not linked (standalone)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 不指向（独立执行仓）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Leaves the chain: this chamber keeps its own name and recipe type (current value is kept).
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 脱离链：本台自行持有名字与配方类型（保留当前值）。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Pointing: %s
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 指向：%s

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Target: %s (rejected if no chamber is there)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 目标：%s（该方向上没有执行仓时会被拒绝）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: The link forms a directed ray: no fork, no loop; the endpoint is the chain head.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 指向连成一条有方向的射线：不分叉、不成环，端点即链首。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Chain: %s chambers, head %s
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 链：%s 台 · 链头 %s

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Chain: standalone (not connected to any chamber)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 链：独立（未与其它执行仓相连）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Name and recipe type are stored only on the chain head and shared by every member.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 名字与配方类型只存在链头那一份上，链上每台共用。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: The head is the chamber reached by following the chain links; there is no "edit just this one".
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 链头 = 沿「链指向」走到的那一台；链上没有「只改这一台」。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: A chamber in this chain still holds unit patterns: the recipe type is locked until they are removed.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 本链上还有执行仓放着单元样板：配方类型已锁定，取走样板后才能改。

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Open the config screen: chain link, recipe type and name (chain-wide, applied to every member)
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 打开配置子界面：设置本执行仓的链指向、配方类型与名字（链上改动整链生效）

gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.en: Send chain link / recipe type / name to the server; the authoritative value is sent back.
gui.rs_create_compat.sequence_execution_.zh: 把链指向 / 配方类型 / 名字发给服务端保存，服务端校验后回发权威值。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_no.en: No chamber on that side: cannot link.
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_no.zh: 该方向上没有执行仓，无法指向。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_cy.en: Cannot link: that would loop back to this chamber (the chain is a directed ray).
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_cy.zh: 不能指向：那会绕回自己（链是一条有方向的射线）。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_fo.en: That chamber is already pointed at by another one: a ray cannot fork.
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_fo.zh: 该仓已被另一台指向：射线不允许分叉。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_to.en: Chain limit reached (8 chambers): cannot link.
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_to.zh: 链已达上限（8 台），无法再接。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_no.en: Nearby chunks are not loaded yet: cannot verify the chain, try again in a moment.
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_link_no.zh: 目标周围区块尚未加载，暂时无法确认链归属，请稍后再试。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_ray_for.en: Old save had a forked chain: this chamber's link was cleared (a ray cannot fork).
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_ray_for.zh: 旧存档里的链出现了分叉：已解除本仓的指向（射线不允许分叉）。

message.rs_create_compat.chamber_ray_cyc.en: Old save had a chain loop: this chamber's link was cleared (the chain is a directed ray).
message.rs_create_compat.chamber_ray_cyc.zh: 旧存档里的链出现了环：已解除本仓的指向（链是一条有方向的射线）。
